form:FormGroup.label: Max Wait For Data
form:FormGroup.helpText: The longest that incomplete data is held back until the rest of it arrives. Data that is already complete does not wait: it becomes queryable on the next merge. Once the wait runs out, whatever has arrived is published as it stands, and anything turning up after that is published on its own. A longer wait keeps more data together; a shorter wait makes incomplete data queryable sooner.

form:FormGroup.label: Bucket Granularity
form:FormGroup.helpText: How the queryable store is partitioned by time: Hour, Day, or Week.
